cues.text: Paulownia Mall. You and Elizabeth walk up to the fountain in the middle of the square.
Elizabeth flings handful after handful of coins into the fountain.
Elizabeth walks off, and you follow to a police box with an officer behind its window.
Elizabeth leads you on to the padded doors of a club behind a rope line.
Elizabeth dances before the closed doors.
Elizabeth walks off to another fountain, then a third, and hurries back to you.
